facades.name: zrinski_vranyczany
facades.source: Street View Oct 2011 (official pano, rectified from 2 frames)
facades.look: Palača Vranyczany-Dobrinović on the west side of the Zrinjevac park: a four-storey neo-renaissance palace in warm ochre-yellow stucco, eleven bays, with a heavily rusticated ground floor and mezzanine (horizontal ochre bands, small windows in plain frames) on a grey granite plinth; in the exact centre a projecting portal with a tall dark double doorway under a semicircular arched fanlight window, flanked by two pairs of stout free-standing stone columns with carved capitals that carry a balustraded stone balcony across the five central bays of the first floor, behind the balcony a large arched window in a pedimented frame; tall first-floor windows with triangular and segmental pediments on brackets, paler cream-yellow upper storeys, small stone balconies with balustrades at both ends of the first floor, a balustraded main cornice; two tall white vertical banners with printed pictures (no readable text) hang between the columns to the left and right of the portal. Copy exactly. Draw NO people, NO parked cars, NO trees, NO street furniture, NO map interface overlay, NO round map icons.
